Roth }} '''Purity of Elements''' is an [[aura]] [[active skill|skill]] that grants [[resistance|elemental resistance]]s and immunity to all elemental [[ailment]]s to the caster and their [[Ally|allies]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== See the [[aura]] page for more details. Unlike the Purity of Cold/Fire/Lightning variants, Purity of Elements does not increase the player's maximum elemental resistances. The player character is still capped at 75% elemental resistances unless they have other sources to increase the maximum cap. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Elemental
Resistance |c1_header = You and nearby allies gain x% to all Elemental Resistances |c1_pattern_extract = You and nearby allies gain %+(%d+)%% to all Elemental Resistances |c1_pattern_value = +%d%% |c2_abbr = Radius |c2_header = +x metres to radius |c2_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c2_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Purity of Elements cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Related modifiers== The following spawnable OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Monster auras== {{status | name = Resists Aura | icon = Purity of Elements skill icon.png | type = Buff | description = Allies Resist Elemental Damage }} Auras similar to Purity of Elements can appear on monsters as a [[monster aura]], like the explicit mod "Resists Aura" or other implicit and unique mods from the mod type "MonsterAuraResists". The mod is displayed in monster nameplate as {{c|mod|Allies Resist Elemental Damage}}. The monster also has the same aura visual effect as the player variant. {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mods.mod_type="MonsterAuraResists" AND domain = "3" |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} Notable monsters that use this aura: * [[Grinning Totem]] The player character can have this aura by using {{il|Headhunter}}, {{il|Replica Headhunter}} or {{il|Inspired Learning}}, which steal auras from slain monsters. ==Gallery== File:Resists Aura.png|A Grinning Totem with the Resists Aura and a monster affected by it {{clear}} ==See also== * {{il|Purity of Fire}} * {{il|Purity of Ice}} * {{il|Purity of Lightning}} * {{sl|Gluttony of Elements}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes you and nearby allies to gain +0-5% to all Elemental Resistances, instead of providing 0-40% increased Area of Effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Purity of Elements now grants {{c|mod|You and nearby Allies are Immune to all Elemental Ailments}} and {{c|mod|You and nearby Allies gain +20-34% to all Elemental Resistances}} (previously 12-27%). * Now has a Reservation of 50% (previously 35%). * Anomalous Purity of Elements no longer grants {{c|mod|You and nearby Allies have +0-2% chance to avoid Elemental Ailments}}. Instead, it now grants {{c|mod|0-10% increased Effect of Aura}}. * The Eternal Labyrinth Enchantment for Purity of Elements Reservation has been changed to match the values of other 50% Reservation Auras. }} {{Version history table row|3.13.0| * Anomalous Purity of Elements now grants you and nearby allies 0.1% chance to avoid elemental ailments per 1% gem quality (from 0.5% per 1% gem quality). * Divergent Purity of Elements now causes your damage and that of nearby allies to penetrate 0.05% of elemental resistances per 1% gem quality (from 0.2% per 1% gem quality). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternative gem [[quality]]. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Now instant by default and can therefore be used while moving. * All instant skills now have cooldown 1 second or less. * Instant skills cannot be supported by Spell Echo and will not be cast a second time by similar effects (such as from the Echoing Shrine). }} {{Version history table row|1.0.1| * Now grants no maximum resistances. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.0| * Maximum resistances provided have been reduced. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.4| * +5% maximum resistances now occurs at level 23 of the Purity aura, rather than level 22. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7| * Purity has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Buffs]]
